cinematic-product-reveal.prompt: Create a cinematic product reveal for a futuristic watch. Put the watch on a dark reflective pedestal, use dramatic rim lighting, slowly rotate the watch, and move the camera toward it.

scene.name: Cinematic Product Reveal
scene.description: A futuristic watch on a dark reflective pedestal with dramatic rim lighting.

neon-cyberpunk.prompt: Create a neon cyberpunk city scene at night. Include glowing buildings, a neon sign, fog, and a flying drone.

scene.name: Neon Cyberpunk City
scene.description: A neon cyberpunk city at night with glowing buildings and fog.

abstract-motion.prompt: Create an abstract motion-graphics scene with floating geometric shapes, a gradient background, and smooth looping animations.

scene.name: Abstract Motion
scene.description: Floating geometric shapes with smooth looping animations.

futuristic-hud.prompt: Create a futuristic UI/HUD scene with a holographic display, glowing wireframe elements, and a rotating central core.

scene.name: Futuristic HUD
scene.description: A holographic display with glowing wireframe elements and a rotating core.

luxury-product.prompt: Create a minimal luxury product advertisement for a perfume bottle. Use a clean studio background, soft lighting, and a slow camera orbit.

scene.name: Luxury Perfume
scene.description: A minimal luxury perfume bottle with soft studio lighting.
